g1.label: 1. First official football rules
g1.why: The Football Association wrote the first official rules in 1863.

g2.label: 2. Oldest football club in the world
g2.why: Sheffield F.C., founded in 1857, is recognised as the world’s oldest football club.

g3.label: 3. The Rugby World Cup trophy is named after
g3.why: It is named after William Webb Ellis, the Rugby School pupil said to have first picked up the ball.

g4.label: 4. How long a cricket match can last
g4.why: A Test match is the longest form of cricket and can run to five days.

g5.label: 5. Traditional Wimbledon food
g5.why: Strawberries and cream is the traditional food eaten at Wimbledon.

g6.label: 6. First Wimbledon Championship
g6.why: The first Wimbledon Championship was played in 1877.

g1.label: 1. Football is played on a ___
g1.why: Football is played on a pitch; a court is for tennis or basketball.

g2.label: 2. Tennis is played on a ___
g2.why: Tennis is played on a court, not a pitch.

g3.label: 3. A group of players together
g3.why: A team is the group of players who play together.

g4.label: 4. The person who enforces the rules
g4.why: The referee makes sure the players follow the rules.

g5.label: 5. When a player gets a goal they ___
g5.why: To score means to get a goal or a point.

g6.label: 6. A single game between two teams
g6.why: A match is one single game between two teams.

g7.label: 7. The winners receive a ___
g7.why: The trophy is the cup or prize the winning team receives.

g8.label: 8. Wimbledon is a famous tennis ___
g8.why: A tournament is a whole series of matches, not just one.
